summary: The short comic video is an illustrated guide featuring a cheerful, winged character who introduces school-age space enthusiasts to the history of NASA's hardware deployed across the solar system since the 1960s.
details: Since the 1960s, NASA has left hardware across the solar system–on the Moon, on Mars, and in deep space. From rovers and instruments that completed their science missions to probes still traveling away from Earth this hardware varies widely in both its purpose and current level of functionality. Your challenge is to tell the story of some or all of this equipment that introduces school-age space enthusiasts to the hardware and the science it made possible. Now generate me a one page comic related to things I mentioned
